findings.finding: The skill correctly distinguished absence from mapped-null for get/getOrDefault, but said 'Only containsKey distinguishes' and did not cover the semantics-changing replacement with computeIfAbsent or putIfAbsent.
findings.consequence: A completed negative lookup represented by mapped-null can be recomputed or replaced. A loader returning null for a missing key creates no new mapping, so checking only the returned value can miss repeated work and policy changes.
